result.note: Single question on the July 2026 arrest of the last absconding Maoist politburo member, a milestone for left-wing extremism; the story has only one testable fact.

questions.prompt: In July 2026, security forces arrested Misir Besra. Which of the following best describes him?
options: Last absconding member of the Maoist politburo
Commander of the armed wing of the NSCN-IM
Founding leader of the United Liberation Front of Asom
Chief of the Kangleipak Communist Party in Manipur
questions.explain: Besra, arrested on 30 July 2026, was the last Maoist politburo member still at large. His arrest leaves India's longest insurgency without leadership and opens a mineral-rich forest belt to mining interest.
questions.source: Security forces arrested Misir Besra, the last absconding Maoist politburo member, leaving India's longest insurgency without leadership and opening a mineral-rich forest belt to mining interest.
